messages:
jess: quick heads-up — CI flagged a binding mismatch when running Nucleus-models with SDK 2.9.0 on runtime 3.12 in the eu-west canary. Thinking we should pin runtime for the nucleus model_group until SDK 2.9.1 lands. @deploybot can you enqueue a temporary pin?

deploybot: received pin request from jess. Please confirm details: model_group=nucleus, target_runtime=3.10, ttl=6h, note='temp pin for SDK 2.9.0 compatibility'. Will not affect dedicated pools unless confirmed by ops. (runbook: /ops/pin-rollback) :robot_face:

sam (sdk): why 3.10 vs 3.11? SDK 2.9.0 change log mentions kernel selector tweaks that should be 3.11-compatible. Do we have a repro?

ken (runtime): quick summary: SDK 2.9.0 ships a new kv-cache layout that hits an unexpected attention kernel path in runtime 3.12 for long-seq cases. 3.10 still uses the previous selector, so it's the safest temporary target. We have a small repro that OOMs in 3.12 canary when seq_len > 2048.

jess: repro attached in thread (see logs). For now I'm asking for a soft pin (no immediate evictions) — route new requests for model_group=nucleus to runtime=3.10 in eu-west only. We want to avoid cross-region ripples.

hao (qa): I ran the repro on the eu-west canary yesterday: stacktrace shows mismatch at kernel_selector.cpp:line 248. I can run a quick regression test matrix (seq 512/1024/2048) if we confirm the pin. ETA ~30m.

irene (sre): we need a rollback plan and an alert window. If we pin, create a short-lived alert on token latency and OOM rate + a 2x token-cost spike threshold. Also list who to call (on-call + runtime leads).

jess: agreed. Proposed plan: 1) deploybot apply soft pin for 6h 2) QA run regression matrix (hao) 3) monitor 10m latency and oom metrics, if healthy, extend to 24h and notify customers in eu-west if SLA-affecting. If any regressions, immediate roll-forward to 3.12 and emergency rollback patch gating.

sam (sdk): we'll cut 2.9.1 today with a shim to fallback to old kv-layout when runtime>=3.12. ETA 6 hours. I'll post release notes and patch diff.

deploybot: command accepted: `/pin add model_group=nucleus runtime=3.10 ttl=21600 note="temp pin for SDK 2.9.0 compatibility" region=eu-west requester=jess`

deploybot: pin applied (soft). Pin id: pin-2026-4350002222. Affected canary shards: nucleus-eu-canary-01..03. No evictions performed.

ken (runtime): adding a quick visibility snippet to release notes and ops:
```
pin: pin-2026-4350002222
model_group: nucleus
runtime: 3.10
region: eu-west
ttl_seconds: 21600
requester: jess
```

jess: thanks. @hao please report regression matrix results here. @irene will you add the alerting temporary rule and the on-call rotation?

hao (qa): regression done: seq512 OK, seq1024 slight throughput drop (~6%), seq2048 repro avoided due to kv-path change — no OOMs observed on 3.10. Logs uploaded: s3://redwood-qa/nucleus/repro/4350002222-report.log

irene (sre): alerting set: nucleus-eu vigilance rule created (latency_p95 > 1200ms or OOM_rate > 0.5% for 5m). Pager rotation: ken -> irene -> jess. Notified #oncall.

sam (sdk): pushing draft 2.9.1 now. Patch includes fallback shim and unit tests. I'll request fast-track review. Will tag the commit in release notes.

jess: decision: keep pin active for now, extend to 24h at 3pm UTC if no regressions. Sam, post the 2.9.1 PR link here and include the exact canary repro steps so we can reference in postmortem if it happens again.

deploybot: pin TTL extended to 86400s by jess at 4350002260. Pin updated: pin-2026-4350002222.

ken (runtime): minor note for release notes: call out model-group routing nuance (model_group-level pins override global runtime autoscaling, see docs link). I'll write a short blurb for the release notes/ops playbook.

hao (qa): quick FYI: ran a stress run with stochastic prompts — no silent corruption observed.

jess: awesome — I'll draft a short internal release note and add a customer-facing blurb if we extend beyond 24h. Closing action items: sam PR, ken release-note blurb, irene alert + rota, hao attach full logs. Will check back in 12h. :thumbsup:
